vendors.name: WooCommerce
vendors.notes: WooCommerce prints operational notices from the same hook as its promotional ones — a pending database update, a gateway that needs configuring. Selecting this hides both.

vendors.name: Elementor
vendors.notes: Covers Elementor and Elementor Pro. Elementor's notices include upgrade prompts and version-mismatch warnings between the two, and this does not tell them apart.

vendors.name: Yoast SEO
vendors.notes: Yoast routes most of its messages through one notification centre, which carries both its upgrade prompts and its configuration warnings.

vendors.name: Rank Math
vendors.notes: Covers Rank Math and its Pro add-on.

vendors.name: Jetpack
vendors.notes: Jetpack's admin notices include its Just In Time Messages, which are marketing, alongside connection and backup warnings, which are not.
